item.title: Driver charged after Harris County baseball coach Tony Dimitri killed in ATV crash
item.description: The Harris County community is grieving the loss of Tony Dimitri, the beloved head baseball coach and teacher at Harris County High School.Dimitri was killed in an ATV crash on Saturday, Jan. 24. The Georgia State Patrol is investigating the crash, which occurred while Dimitri was a passenger in an ATV driven by his friend, 44-year-old Darrell Guthrey.
